title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Fisher Divergence Critic Regularization

methods.one_paragraph_description: Fisher-BRC (Behavior Regularized Critic): parameterizes the critic as log of a fitted behavior policy mu(a|s) plus a learned state-action offset O_theta(s,a); trains with the SAC-style TD loss on O+log mu plus a gradient penalty lambda*E||grad_a O||^2 on the offset (equivalent to Fisher divergence regularization). Actor is SAC-style, maximizing the regularized critic. Requires pretraining a behavior density model.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL; behavior regularization ('Behavior regularization is a prominent approach to offline' RL, Section 2); model-free actor-critic; 'connections with energy-based models'

base_algorithm_hyperparameters.value: default SAC hyperparameters, no entropy in rewards
base_algorithm_hyperparameters.quote: Actor and critic learning Our implementation is based on Soft Actor Critic (Haarnoja et al., 2019). As in CQL we do not add entropy to the rewards and we modify the critic loss to accommodate the additional regularization term. We use default SAC hyper parameters without additional tuning, in contrast to CQL and BRAC which tune policy learning rate.

behavior_policy_model.value: conditional Mixture of Gaussians, 5 components, tanh squashing; 3-layer MLP 256 relu; Adam 1e6 steps, lr 1e-3 decayed x10 at 8e5 and 9e5 steps
behavior_policy_model.quote: Behavior policy We fit the behavior model using a conditional Mixture of Gaussians (Bishop, 1994) with tanh squash- ing (Haarnoja et al., 2017). We use 5 mixture components. We train the density model with Adam optimizer (Kingma & Ba, 2014) for 106 steps and starting from learning rate 10−3 and decreasing it by 10 at 8 · 105 and 9 · 105 gradient update steps. Similar to BRAC we train the behavior actor with SAC-style entropy regularization with the same target entropy. We parameterize the model as a 3 layer MLP with relu activations and 256 hidden units.
